newsitem.title: UK: BA says consults lawyers on strike.
newsitem.headline: BA says consults lawyers on strike.

text.p: British Airways Plc said on Wednesday it was in "active discussion" with its lawyers on possible legal action against a strike by cabin crew which grounded more than half its flights from London.
British Airways says a strike by the Transport and General Workers Union (T & G) members is illegal because of discrepancies in the strike ballot.
BA said the T & G were insisting the strike was legal, but it remained convinced the strike was unlawful.
"We are now in active discussion with our legal advisers," Mervyn Walker, BA director of human resources told a news conference.
"We have the right to damages in respect of losses we incur, and to other legal remedies".
Walker said a legal injunction against the strike was another possible option but would not say whether this was being considered.
BA declined to specify the losses it had incurred so far as a result of the strike.
